svg.text: Fetchers: the model in mind vs the one built
Arpit's description (2026-09-21) on the left, the shipped design on the right. Same consumer freedom; different key, different pairing, no crawl.
THE MODEL IN MIND -- one fetcher per document KIND, each handing to its decoder, links followed
every link the html decoder finds goes back
Frontier is unbounded and order-dependent; the
corpus becomes whatever the web linked to today.
- http and cdp are just the two shipped ones
- every fetched thing goes through a decoder
- xlsx, html, images each have their decoder
- a fetcher knows the format before it fetches
THE ONE BUILT -- one fetcher per transport / host, the LINE pairs it with a decoder, links are edges
One cdp fetcher, three formats. The format
is a fact about the document; the transport
is a fact about the host. Both are written
once, at fux add, and re-used at answer time.
decoder= from Content-Type; DoD 10 makes it declared.
What happens to a link in a.html
-> target not in the list: nothing
Nothing is fetched because a page said so.
The corpus is the committed list; ingest is
a pure function of it (L2, L3, L4).
Want discovery? fux add --follow N would fetch
a page and WRITE lines for you to commit.
THE DIFFERENCES, IN ONE LINE EACH
in mind: per document kind (xlsx, html, image). built: per transport / host. Kind x transport would be N x M fetchers; the line already carries both halves.
in mind: the fetcher picks its decoder. built: the URL line declares decoder= once; the refer plane re-uses the same pair at answer time to prove freshness.
in mind: decoder finds links, fetchers follow them, recursively. built: a link is a graph edge to a document already in the list, or nothing.
in mind: an image decoder indexes images. built: image.py reads PNG/EXIF/GIF text metadata only -- no OCR, no vision model (L1, L3).
not in mind: the fetcher runs again at fux answer -- re-fetch, re-decode, fresh sha, verdict current / stale / cached / unverified.
Left: Arpit, Cowork, 2026-09-21. Right: src/fux/ingest/urlsrc.py, routes.py, edges.py, .fux/fetchers/, .fux/decoders/, same day. W-199 DoD 10 pending.
